make.description: The manufacturer or brand of the pyrometer (e.g., Optris, Fluke, Raytek)

model.description: The specific product designation given by the manufacturer, identifying the pyrometer type or version (e.g., Optris CTlaser 3M, Fluke 568)

serialNumber.description: A unique identifier assigned by the manufacturer to distinguish an individual pyrometer unit from others of the same make and model

assetId.description: A unique identifier assigned to each asset in the organisation’s asset registry

maximum.description: Maximum thermal radiation wavelength that the pyrometer's detector is sensitive to

minimum.description: Minimum thermal radiation wavelength that the pyrometer's detector is sensitive to

maximum.description: Maximum temperature the pyrometer is calibrated to measure accurately (e.g. 500°C to 2500°C)

minimum.description: Minimum temperature the pyrometer is calibrated to measure accurately (e.g. 500°C to 2500°C)
